subject: rstan - Error in .local(object, ...) :    the model object is not created or not valid

messages.author: cf47bbe63da1f3ae
messages.subject: rstan - Error in .local(object, ...) :    the model object is not created or not valid
parts: This happens when I have a model object created in a previous R session, reload the saved object, and try to run something like constrain_pars or log_prob on the model. Seems like a bug...

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: rstan - Error in .local(object, ...) :    the model object is not created or not valid
parts:
On Monday, October 3, 2016 at 5:02:24 PM UTC-4, Charles Driver wrote:
This happens when I have a model object created in a previous R session, reload the saved object, and try to run something like constrain_pars or log_prob on the model. Seems like a bug...
It is a known issue. The class methods get lost across R sessions since they are part of the DLL.
